data.title: Archive eligible terminal tasks with guarded canonical history preservation
acceptance: Guarded compaction retains open task graphs, active ownership and durable Factory completion subjects while preserving every prior history event.
Eligible obsolete terminal task records are archived recoverably, with remaining branches, worktrees and ownership documented.

data.text: Explicitly authorized global maintenance; existing local canonical store verified against repository origin and its own project mapping. Factory global resolver divergence is bypassed using exact task-scoped canonical origin. Preserve active work, ownership, source and event history. No installed runtime activation.
